text:
Mira: Heads up — ACME asked for per-route SLO parity with CompetitorX and wants it prioritized for Q2. They said migration is contingent on it. Thoughts?

Alex: Ack. Do we have telemetry on how many customers asked for per-route SLOs?

Sam: ACME is big but not unique. Seen ~5 asks in tickets + 2 customer calls. The core ask is route-level budgets + fallback policies.

Jonah: Tech reality: per-route SLOs touch routing policy, autoscaling hooks, KV/cache invalidation, and console UX. Ballpark 6–8 sprints if we go full parity.

Lisa: We should avoid a full one-to-one parity rip. Proposal: ship a "parity-lite" that covers Hosted quick wins, and keep full parity for Dedicated/Private as a later track. Keeps momentum and differentiation. :thinking:

Mira: Agree. Draft launch criteria idea: 1) API + Console UI to create/list per-route SLOs; 2) routing fallback that enforces budget; 3) canary with 2 pilot customers on Private/Hosted; 4) docs + sales enablement kit. Anything missing?

Sam: Add observability requirements: per-route token/latency breakdowns, alerting, and a small eval suite to validate regressions.

Alex: Tradeoffs: parity-lite reduces scope and ship time, but sales will ask why not full parity. Suggest two parallel tracks: QuickShip (8 wks) and Full Parity (Q3). Attach cost estimates for both. :thumbsup:

Jonah: Minimal routing policy prototype shape (to discuss in spec):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "slo_ms": 250,
  "fallback_model": "gpt-compat",
  "autoscale": "opt-in"
}
```

Lisa: For GTM: ship QuickShip as Hosted-only beta with a flag for Dedicated. Call it "SLO Controls (beta)" and emphasize graceful degradation + predictable costs. Positioning: not copying CompetitorX, but offering a pragmatic step that unlocks predictability for small teams.

Mira: Who owns the sprint-slice spec? Alex + Jonah on tech spec. Sam owns observability + evals. Lisa owns GTM + sales kit. I'll draft a proposal by EOD and we sync tomorrow 10:00am. @Sam can you pull usage counts and ticket IDs?

Sam: On it. Will drop query + counts here. Quick note: early estimate shows 7 customers with explicit per-route asks (3 trial, 4 enterprise).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: branch/route-slo-proto -> staging at 20:00 :rocket:

Alex: One more thing — pricing decision. Do we offer first 2 routes free and charge for additional route controls? Need finance input.

Mira: Propose free for first 2 routes, premium for advanced controls (multi-tenant routing, autoscale hooks). Add to spec.

Jonah: Risk callout for the spec: routing complexity may increase tail latency; include a control-plane SLO and automated fallback to simpler routing for high tail.

Lisa: GTM note: messaging should highlight "predictable SLA controls + graceful degradation" not "we just matched CompetitorX" — keeps us differentiated.

Mira: Great. I'll post the draft spec link in this thread before the 10:00 sync. Thanks all.

Sam: I'll paste query results + ticket list by 9am tomorrow.

Alex: Will prep a short RACI and rough cost bands for QuickShip vs Full Parity.

Jonah: I'll stub out the minimal API contract and a canary checklist tonight.

Lisa: I'll start a one-pager for sales with positioning bullets.

Mira: Perfect. Meeting tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
